== Summary ==
Slip “•With Thunderous Applause” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 819, 581, 1542)). Version [[With Thunderous Applause]] (Original). Not a recreation.
